english.title: Engage in water sports without permission - Port of Liverpool
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) engaged or took part in

(A)_[water skiing]_
(B)_[aquaplaning]_
(C)_[paragliding,]_
(D)_[power boat racing]_
(E)_[parakiting]_
(F)_[parachute towing]_
(G)_[a watersport activity, namely **(..SPECIFY ACTIVITY..)]_

without the written permission of the harbour master
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 38(h) and 39(a) of the Port of Liverpool General Byelaws 2021.
